rows.rewrite: net billing price for kWh supplied by prosumer to licensee
rows.answer:
Under a net‑billing arrangement, the kilowatt‑hours that you export to the licensee are billed at the **national average energy purchase price** [S1].  

If you have a distributed‑generator agreement that was executed under the repealed Net Metering Regulations, the savings clause says you are billed at the **national average power purchase price** until that agreement expires, and thereafter at the **national average energy purchase price** for any renewals [S6].

[S1] Prosumer Regs 2026, reg. 14(1), p. 6
[S6] Prosumer Regs 2026, reg. 21(2), p. 7

rows.rewrite: distributed generation facility capacity greater than sanctioned load net metering
rows.answer:
Under the current Prosumer Regulations 2026, the capacity of a proposed distributed‑generation (solar) facility must not exceed the sanctioned load of the applicant’s premises; the Authority may only increase it later by notification [S1].  

The earlier Net‑Metering Regulations 2015 (now repealed) had permitted a capacity up to one‑and‑a‑half times the sanctioned load, but that rule no longer applies except for licences and agreements that were executed before the 2026 regulations came into force, as specified in the savings clause of the Prosumer Regulations 2026 [S4][S6].

[S1] Prosumer Regs 2026, reg. 3(2), p. 2
[S4] NM amendment 2018, text, p. 1 (repealed)
[S6] Prosumer Regs 2026, reg. 21(2), p. 7

rows.rewrite: DISCO meter reading procedures detection bill
rows.answer:
Meter reading of all DISCO consumers is done on a routine monthly basis by DISCO staff, with consumers divided into batches and sub‑batches so that the meters in each batch are normally read on the same dates each month [S2]. For connections that have an AMR system, a separate batch is created and billing is carried out remotely according to a schedule made by DISCO [S1]. If a force majeure prevents actual reading, the consumer may submit a meter‑reading snapshot to DISCO or DISCO may issue a provisional bill based on last year’s or average consumption, with the final bill issued after normalization [S3].

[S2] Consumer Service Manual 2025, clause 6.1.1, p. 45
[S1] Consumer Service Manual 2025, clause 6.3, p. 48
[S3] Consumer Service Manual 2025, clause 6.1.1.1, p. 45
